el.Pop melancólico y psicodélico, sintetiza: Melancholic, psychedelic pop with 80s and 90s synthesizers and heartbreak lyrics
el.La música pop melancólica y psicodélica: The melancholic, psychedelic pop of Lu Glass, composed mainly on hybrid analog-digital synthesizers from the '80s and '90s, takes shape in songs with instrumental landscapes and lyrics drawn from literary tropes and heartbreak.
el.En su formación actual, el proyecto adqu: In its current lineup, the project gains electronic power with the addition of Paula Díaz Mendilharzu and her setup of Roland TD-03, MPC, JV 1080 module and Minilogue.

el.Lu Glass lanzó su primer disco, El Rayo,: Lu Glass released her first album, El Rayo, in 2016, capturing her sonic identity in layers of dreamlike synthesizers, minimalist beats and precise lyrics. With the band she brought together to play live, she recorded a covers EP and they opened for The Radio Dept.
el.Después de años de presentarse en escena: After years of playing local and international stages, including a standout performance at the first Buenos Aires edition of the Primavera Sound festival, she produced En la ribera de la noche plutónica.
